verdict.rationale: BVNK documents a webhook listener setup that delivers real-time notifications of account changes [bvnk-docs-2]. You can subscribe to specific events through an Events field, for example `bvnk:ledger:report:ready` [bvnk-docs-32]. A webhook signature validator is also provided for verifying deliveries [bvnk-docs-21, bvnk-docs-30]. Missing for 10: a full catalog of subscribable event types, documented retry/delivery semantics, API-based subscription management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
